thread:
alex_p: Quick heads-up — vendor pushed a new HW timeline this morning. H200 GA window slipped, and there's a patch-level requirement for MI300 that affects marketplace images. Need cross-org sync to update embargo, SKU tags, and SI cert plan. :eyes:

marta_vendor: Yep — confirmed from vendor call. H200 moved from 2025-02 to 2025-04, and B200 has a thermal derate note on certain SKUs. They want a joint announcement window but only after SI images pass smoke tests.

raj_eng: Can we get specifics on the thermal derate? affects rack power planning and bench images. if it's power gating we need to update perf guidance.

marta_vendor: Short: some B200 SKUs hit thermal derate at sustained 700W under our long-run benchmark. They suggested firmware rev 1.2.3 as mitigation, but that rev isn't cleared in our lab yet.

liam_si: SI side: we need the final firmware and a reproducible test plan. We'll need 48h of soak runs on our integration bench. Please share the firmware build and test vector.

alex_p: Proposed agenda for sync: 1) final GA dates and embargo windows, 2) firmware status + lab timeline, 3) marketplace SKU tagging and image release cadence, 4) SI certification runway + handoff, 5) comms/press constraints. Who needs to join?

sophia_market: Marketplace: we require signed SKU matrix and image SHA before any SKU unlock. Also need to confirm regional availability (APAC). If the embargo slips, we push the marketplace announce by the same delta.

raj_eng: Tagging note: we'll need a new test image label scheme: `redwood/v1-hw-compat/{vendor}/{sku}/{fw}` so automated gating works. Example:
```
redwood/v1-hw-compat/gaudi/B200/fw-1.2.3
```
Make sure vendors produce images with matching naming.

marta_vendor: We'll ask partner engineering to adopt that tag pattern. Also can provide a delta list of SKUs affected by derate by EOD.

calendar-bot: alex_p scheduled a 45m sync: "HW Marketplace + SI handoff — embargo & SKU stability" on 2025-03-18 16:00 PT with attendees alex_p, marta_vendor, raj_eng, sophia_market, liam_si. Invite sent. :calendar:

liam_si: Thanks — we'll prep the SI acceptance criteria doc. Quick ask: can someone add the required soak-run config snippet to the doc? saves time.

raj_eng: Adding a minimal config block now:
```
soak_run:
  duration: 48h
  load: longbench_v2
  telemetry: power,temp,kv_hit_rate
  fail_if: temp > 85C or perf_drop > 10%
```

marta_vendor: We'll target delivering firmware build and SKU delta by tomorrow EOD. If lab finds regressions, may push GA by 2 weeks — will update in sync.

alex_p: Action items before sync (assigning):
- marta_vendor: firmware build + SKU delta (due: EOD tomorrow)
- raj_eng: create marketplace image naming doc + CI gating PR (due: +48h)
- liam_si: SI acceptance template + soak config (due: +48h)
- sophia_market: draft embargo wording and regional availability constraints (due: sync)

sophia_market: noted. Also flagging: marketing needs a 7-day embargo prep window for partner quotes and legal sign-off.

marta_vendor: Understood. I'll escalate to partner comms to reserve the 7-day window if we hit GA.

alex_p: If anything changes before Thu morning, drop updates here. Otherwise we'll triage in the sync. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

liam_si: one more — can we include a short runbook for rollback if SI tests fail in prod? Even a stub helps. I'll draft and push to the shared drive.

raj_eng: good call. I'll add a fallback policy: route to H100-compatible variant with reduced batch size + alerting.

marta_vendor: copying vendor PM on the calendar invite so they can join if needed.

alex_p: closing thread — see calendar invite.
